title: Explorer FeatureUsage
whyItMatters: FeatureUsage tracks use of Windows Explorer features such as search and library views, adding detail about how the machine was used.
notes: Subkeys such as ShowedUI and AppLaunch are counted but not parsed. Present from Windows 10 onward.

steps: Only if you are not doing the full reset at the end of this plan, and you are comfortable with Registry Editor:
Open Registry Editor and go to the key named in the plan; Windows has no settings page for this record.
Delete that key, then close Registry Editor.
cleanup.risk: Removes the Explorer feature usage record for this account. Windows starts a new record as soon as Explorer is used again.
